column3: With respect to the Storage of America Portfolio 2 Mortgage Loan (7.5%), at origination the related borrowers obtained an environmental insurance policy that covers the SOA – Gustine Property, the SOA - Rock Island Property, the SOA - Kitridge Property and the SOA - Dort Hwy Property (relating to an HREC due to three historical inground hydraulic lifts and a 1,000- gallon used oil UST which were identified and removed). The policy is with Beazley Excess and Surplus Insurance, Inc. (rated “A+” by S&P and “A:XV” by A.M. Best) that provides a $5,000,000 policy
